source_checkpoint.availability_boundary: The workbook is an external controlled programme artifact and is not copied into this public data repository. Reproduction requires bytes matching this SHA-256 digest.

public_url: remove trailing slash except for root
checksum: treat empty, N/A, NA, NONE, UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, and NOT CLAIMED-prefixed values as unresolved
normalization_contract.identity: Automatic grouping uses exact normalized URL and/or exact normalized checksum only. No fuzzy, semantic, title, publisher, embedding, or model-based identity inference is permitted.

reproduction_contract: Verify that the input workbook bytes match source_checkpoint.sha256.
Read only the named workbook surfaces and raw-CSV successor paths recorded above.
Construct the 248-source effective universe as 224 baseline rows plus the 12 v1.6 and 12 v1.7 additions.
Apply the pinned Workbench URL/checksum normalization semantics.
Resolve assessment evidence only by explicit current source ID, exact normalized URL, or exact normalized checksum.
For unresolved evidence, group registration proposals only by exact normalized URL/checksum connected identity.
Keep evidence with neither exact key nor a valid explicit current source ID unresolved for human curation.
Do not mutate completed assessments, existing source releases, or monitoring registries during reproduction.
